content: Nati wenina mbuta wa mukwandi mu Kipfumu kya mazilu?
Muna tangwa meni dina, balonguki bábwesuka kwena Yesu mu kuzimbula: «Nati si wenina mbuta wa mukwandi mu Kipfumu kya mazilu?»
Hanga wutedi mwana mosi, wámusya hana kati dya bawu,
amana wuzimbudi: «Mu kyedika yiluzimbwadi, yukani lusobiku, amana lwakituka hanga bana, lwakótamwoku mu Kipfumu kya mazilu.
Disongidila, wosu wuna wadíkulumuna hanga mwana yandu, kakála mbuta wa mukwandi mu Kipfumu kya mazilu.
Amana wosu wuna wuyambi mwana mosi mu khumbu ya meni, meni kayambini.
Kebenu mu kusumuka
«Amana wuna wuhukumuni mosi wa bana bakhunda baba bisi kwikila mwena meni, bulungi kwena yandi bamuzitikila kalunga tadi hana tsingu amana bamudibula muna dingu dya yanga dya mbuta.
Khi kyadi kwena tsi kikuma kya bisinza, mu kyedika, bwalendaku salama ni kukalaku mambu mana misi sumuna; kaasi kyadi kwena wuna kyalúbwakila kisinza!

Amana yukani koku dyaku holo kulu dyaku dyakusumunaka, bukunadya amana losadya ku kyana yi ngeyi; bulungi kwena ngeyi wakota mu luzingu yi koku dimosi holo kulu dimosi, ka mboti ku ni wakala yi malu modi holo moku modi amana bakulosa ku mbawu ya mvula yi mvula.

Amana yuka ni disu dyaku dyakusumunaka, lokuladya amana losadya ku kyana yi ngeyi; bulungi kwena ngeyi wakota mu luzingu lwakonda tsuka yi disu dimosi, ka mboti ku ni wakala kwaku yi mesu modi amana bakulosa ku bilungi.»
Kingana kya mukoku watota amana wamonika
«Talenu, lulewulaku mosi wa bana bakhunda baba; mukuma yiluzimbwadi ni banzyo ba bawu muna mazilu bisi tala kosu tangwa mbunzu ya Tata wama wuna wenina mu mazilu.
[Mukuma Mwana wa mutu kisa hulula bana bátota.]
«Abweti lwisi banza? Yukani mutu mosi kavwa mikoku khama, amana mosi muna kati dya myawu katota, kasísaku makumi vwa yi vwa muna mongu ndangu kenda sanda wuna wátota?
Amana yuka ni kasengumunawa, mu kyedika, yiluzimbwadi, kasángwala kikuma kya wawu kuluta makumi vwa yi vwa ma mina myakonda tota.
Phila mosi, lweku luzolu lwa Tata wenu wuna wenina muna mazilu, ni mosi mu kati dya baleki baba katota.»
Buna phangi mosi kakuhanga mbi
«Yukani phangi waku kasumuka [kwena ngeyi], ndawenda, mumona, kalenu benu boodi lwesi. Yukani kakuyukila, wumunungini phangi waku.
Kaasi yukani kayukiku, bonga hika mutu mosi kondilo boodi ha kimosi yi ngeyi, ndangu mu ndinga ya bambangi boodi kondilo batatu dyambu dyosu dyayilama."
Kaasi yukani kabwisa kubayukila, zimbula ku Dibundu; amana yuka ni kabwisa phi kuyukila Dibundu, kakala kikuma kya ngeyi hanga muphakanu yi kalaki ka phaku.
«Mu kyedika, yiluzimbwadi, moosu mana lwakása ha tsi makásama ku zilu, amana moosu mana lwakútumuna ha tsi makútumuka ku zilu.
«Mu kyedika, yiluzimbwadi hika ni yuka boodi ha kati dya benu bayukana, ha tsi haha, mu kulomba kyosu kima, kyakina kabáheka Tata wama wenina mu mazilu.
Mukuma hana henina bodi holo batatu bakhundakana mu khumbu yama, meni yenina hana kati dya bawu.»
Kingana kya musadi mosi wisiku zola kulolula
Hanga buna kábwesuka Phetelu wumuzimbwadi: «Pfumu, mbala kwa pfwani kulolula kwena phangi wama yandu wuphangi mbi, amana yimúlolula tii yi kuna mbala tsambwadi?»
Yesu wumuzimbwadi: «Yikuzimbwadiku ni yi kuna mbala tsambwadi, kaasi yi kuna mbala makumi tsambwadi yi tsambwadi.
Ihana ni, Kipfumu kya mazilu kifwanakani yi kyamvu mosi wázola kutala mambu ma pfuka zandi kwena basadi bandi.
Amana buna káyandika mu kusalabwa, bisa munatina mosi wáfwana kufuta mafunda yi mafunda ma mbongu.
Bwosu kakalaku yi kima kya kufuta, pfumu wandi wáhana muswa ndangu bamutekisa yandi yi mukhetu wandi yi bana bandi yi bima byosu bina kákala byawu, ndangu bafuta pfuka yandi.
Musadi wábwa muna malu mandi amana wáfukama kuna thwala yandi mu kuzonza: "Sipha mbundu pfumu, kikuma kya meni, yikufuta pfuka yosu!"
Kiwayi kyámukwata pfumu wa musadi wuna, wámusula kenda amana wámuyambwadilaya pfuka.
Mu kulubuka, musadi wuna bátundakana yi mosi wa banduku ba kisalu wuna wafwana kumufuta mbongu za khunda. Musadi wámukwata, amana wáyandika mu kumukama hana dinga mu kuzimbula: "Futa pfuka yama!"
Hanga nduku wa kisalu wubwi muna malu mandi, kakala mubokwadila: "Sipha mbundu kikuma kya meni, yikufuta!"
Kaasi yandi kázolaku; wenda mutimbula mu boloku, yi kuna kafútila pfuka yina.
Mu kumona mana mabwa, banduku bandi ba kisalu kyadi kyábakwata lawu; hanga bendi menika kwena pfumu wa bawu mosu mana máluta.
Hanga pfumu wumutedisi amana wumuzimbwadi: "Musadi wa mbi! Yikuyambwadidiki pfuka yaku kikuma wumbokwadidiki;
wulungikiku, ngeyi phi kuyukila nduku waku wa kisalu kiwayi, bwosu yikuyukidiki phi ngeyi kiwayi?"
Amana pfumu wandi, mu khabu, wámulambula mu boloku tii yi kuna kafútila byosu bina káfwana mu kufuta.»
«Yi bwabuna phi Tata wama wenina ku zilu kalúhanga yukani mosi-mosi wa benu kaloludiku kwena phangi wandi yi mbundu yandi yosu.»
